### The Fruit of Worship
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/the-fruit-of-worship
Passage: Psalm 92:1-4
Points:
- Worship magnifies God so that personal concerns are eclipsed in His presence.
- Centering on the Lord expands our horizons beyond self-imposed boundaries.
- Communing with God drives away inner fears and gnawing anxieties.
- Encountering the living God changes our perspective and calms troubled hearts.
- Integrating praise throughout daily life transforms our attitude toward our work.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 7/24
Author: Wisdom from the Psalms
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-7-or-24-552466.html
Passage: Psalm 92:3
Points:
- Musical instruments in Scripture illustrate heartfelt worship rather than external ritual.
- Worshipful music reflects the divine harmony and beauty of God's creation.
- Believers are called to let praise fill their hearts and define their identity.
- Seeking God removes spiritual discord so our lives harmonize with His divine purposes.

### Psalm 92: A Song for the Sabbath
Author: W. Robert Godfrey
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/psalm-92-song-sabbath
Passage: Psalm 92:1-15
Points:
- Sabbath worship exists to exalt the Lord and reorient our hearts around His rule.
- Praise reminds believers that worldly evildoers will face final, righteous judgment.
- God sustains His people like sturdy trees so they remain fruitful in old age.
- Proclaiming God's steadfast love and faithfulness provides assurance through all trials.
- The Sabbath day ultimately points believers to Christ, our risen King and Sabbath rest.
